claim_tested: A Gln can occupy the block III oxyanion position of an SGNH hydrolase
key_finding: Crystal structure of an SGNH hydrolase in which the canonical block III Asn is replaced; the Gln side-chain amide donates to the oxyanion hole
confidence_and_limitations: High for the precedent, indirect for At5g03810: the precedent protein is not a plant GELP

key_finding: Ser37 OG to His331 NE2 2.73 A; His331 ND1 to Asp328 OD 2.74 A; per-residue pLDDT >98 at all three; geometry tighter than the four experimental SGNH structures examined (PDB-derived distances 2.8-3.4 A)
context: in silico model of the Arabidopsis protein
confidence_and_limitations: High for geometry, but a model is not an experiment; no ligand, no kinetics

citation: This work (27 Arabidopsis GELP AlphaFold models)
key_finding: Gln at the block III position in all 5 members of the At5g03810 clade and in 0 of the remaining 22 Arabidopsis GELPs modelled; the Gln amide N is 3.0-3.4 A from Ser37 OG, within oxyanion-hole range
confidence_and_limitations: Medium-high; clade assignment rests on pairwise identity and UPGMA, not maximum-likelihood phylogeny

claim_tested: The Gln substitution is fixed, not a lineage artifact
key_finding: Ser37, Gln173, Asp328 and His331 identical in 20 of 20 homologs (Ser absent only in a 209-aa fragment); all members are Brassicaceae, so no sequence outside Brassicaceae reaches the 50 percent identity threshold
confidence_and_limitations: High for conservation; UniRef50 membership depends on the clustering threshold and is not a phylogeny

claim_tested: Can the APG annotation transfer to At5g03810
key_finding: APG/At3g16370 was described as anther-specific; At5g03810 is 55.5 percent identical to APG and its protein peaks in seed, so the tissue label does not transfer
confidence_and_limitations: Medium; the original APG work predates quantitative proteomics

key_finding: At5g03810 peptides quantified in 11 of 30 tissues, maximum in mature imbibed seed (8034); At5g03820 in 25 tissues and At5g22810 in 20, both seed-maximal at 15-50x higher abundance; APG petal-maximal in 30/30; EXL4 pollen-maximal in 30/30
confidence_and_limitations: High for existence, medium for tissue specificity: detection depends on tissue-specific dynamic range

claim_tested: Is a characterised Arabidopsis GELP close enough to transfer substrate class
key_finding: SFAR4/At3g48460 hydrolyses short-chain p-nitrophenyl esters; it is 26.1 percent identical to At5g03810, far outside the 55-90 percent clade, so its substrate preference cannot be transferred
context: recombinant protein, Arabidopsis seed and pollen expression
confidence_and_limitations: High for the measured identity, which is the point: this is a negative transfer result

claim_tested: Is GO:0008610 lipid biosynthetic process justified
key_finding: The sole experimentally characterised IBA source protein is Pseudomonas aeruginosa EstA, EC 3.1.1.1, active on C4-C6 p-nitrophenyl esters, whose contribution to rhamnolipid production its own record calls unclear; the second source Q9HUP2 is uncharacterised
confidence_and_limitations: High for provenance, which is what is being audited

key_finding: Single N-terminal hydropathy peak (max 1.95 at residue 12), no internal peak above 1.6, Gly at -3 and -1 of a cleavage site after Gly24, mean pLDDT 51.4 over 1-24 against 97.1 over 25-353, three disulfides at 2.02-2.04 A with free Cys only at 10 and 16
